messages:
Ravi K: Hey folks, Juneteenth (Jun 19) fell inside the company maintenance blackout this year and I was scheduled on urgent client coverage. Can I get comp time or carry it over? cc @People Ops
People Ops: Hi Ravi  short answer: for statutory holidays missed due to mandatory blackout we can either pro-rate carryover or offer a one-time compensatory floating day. Manager confirmation + blackout-exception form required.
Ravi K: Where's the form and is there a deadline?
People Ops: Form: https://intranet.redwood/hr-forms/blackout-exception. Submit within 30 days of blackout end for normal handling. If you want a payroll payout instead, note payroll cutoff: submit at least 15 business days before payroll run.
Lena M: I confirm Ravi was on the coverage rota that day; happy to add manager note.
Ravi K: Thanks Lena. I'll submit and select "compensation". Marking urgent.
calendar-bot: Reminder: maintenance blackout Jun 17-20. See https://calendar.redwood/blackouts
People Ops: Received once submitted. We'll open an HR case and apply pro-rated hours (e.g., 3/5 = 0.6 day -> converted to hours) or add a floating day. Expect update in 3-5 business days. :white_check_mark:
